game.title: Chaupar / Pachisi
game.description: The 'Game of Kings,' an ancient board game played by Mughal emperors and Indian royalty. Precursor to Ludo, involving strategy and chance with cowrie shells as dice.
howToPlay: Step 1: The cross-shaped board has squares arranged in a symmetrical pattern.
Step 2: Each player chooses colored pieces and places them in the center.
Step 3: Players throw cowrie shells to determine moves.
Step 4: The number of shells landing with opening up determines the move count.
Step 5: Players move pieces along the squares toward the center.
Step 6: Landing on an opponent's square sends their piece back to start.
Step 7: Safe squares protect pieces from capture.
Step 8: All pieces must reach the center to win.
Step 9: Strategy involves deciding which pieces to move and when.
Step 10: The first player to get all pieces home wins.
